answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, like a meadow gate that only opens after a season of roots: each identity must also finish a unique onyx-stamped proof-of-work task tied to its wallet, so a farm cannot wander in with a thousand cheap clones. A farm is caught when 20+ identities share one funding wallet or identical timing within 10 minutes; the detector freezes them and slashes 50 percent of each stake, so 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA locked plus 250,000 slashed, more than any harvest.
